events.factual_description: FringeArts presents Holland Andrews and yuniya edi kwon's How does it feel to look at nothing from September 25 through 27, 2026 at 140 N Columbus Blvd in Philadelphia. The September 25 and 26 performances begin at 7:30 PM; September 27 begins at 2:00 PM. FringeArts lists a 70-minute runtime and advertised prices of $50 Supporter, $35 General Admission, $15 Student & 25-and-Unders, and $2 FringeACCESS. The presenter describes the new opera as entirely improvised and combining music, dance, ritual, and projection; it credits Andrews and edi kwon as co-creators and performers. yuniya edi kwon's official schedule labels the Philadelphia run WORLD PREMIERE EAST, after a WORLD PREMIERE WEST run in Portland on September 11-13 and before later Seattle and BAM performances. This record therefore treats Philadelphia as the announced East Coast premiere rather than claiming it is the first performance anywhere.

en.why_it_matters: The composition is not a fixed object here. Andrews and edi kwon build the opera in real time from voices, instruments, movement, ritual, and mutual response, so the Philadelphia East Coast premiere is an early public form of a work that can genuinely change from night to night. That combination of full improvisation and staged scale gives the run a specific live reason to exist in RADAR.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the three Philadelphia performances if the corridor is open that weekend. Because the work continues through its premiere-season tour and Philadelphia itself offers three chances, choose the date that fits the trip rather than treating a single performance as irreplaceable.
en.listen_before: No fixed pre-listen — the work is entirely improvised.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí la composición no es un objeto fijo. Andrews y edi kwon construyen la ópera en tiempo real con voces, instrumentos, movimiento, ritual y respuesta mutua, así que el estreno de la Costa Este en Filadelfia es una forma pública temprana de una obra que puede cambiar de verdad de una noche a otra. Esa combinación de improvisación total y escala escénica le da a la función una razón en vivo muy concreta para entrar al RADAR.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las tres funciones en Filadelfia si el corredor está abierto ese fin de semana. Como la obra continúa dentro de su temporada de estrenos y Filadelfia ofrece tres oportunidades, escogería la fecha que mejor encaje en el viaje en vez de tratar una sola función como irreemplazable.
es.listen_before: Sin escucha previa fija: la obra es enteramente improvisada.
